title: Grandpa Bows For The Holiday Card
trend: TikTok 'Paparazzi Bowing' (pose for the camera, then bow deeply on the beat drop of a sped-up remix; Virlo current TikTok trends, rising, Oct-Nov 2026, US) + holiday card photo season (family matching-sweater photos in November) — Renata tries to take the family holiday card photo on a phone timer, but Grandpa Gus bows deeply at every flash 'for the fans', Duchess the dog demands a solo headshot and teen Eli blinks; twist: Grandpa was the town's TV weatherman who bowed after every forecast for thirty years, he put the shoot in the neighborhood newsletter, and a crowd across the street has been taking pictures the whole time — the best card photo is the neighbors' shot of the whole family bowing
youtube_title: The holiday card photo, but Grandpa bows after every flash 📸
description:
Renata has one goal: one nice holiday card photo. Grandpa Gus bows after every flash. The dog wants a solo shot, and the street has questions.

#cartoon #animation #funny #grandpa #shorts
tiktok_caption: the holiday card photo, but Grandpa bows after every flash 📸 #cartoon #animation #funny #grandpa

lines.text: One nice holiday card photo. Matching sweaters. Big smiles. That is all I ask.
Three. Two. One.
Thank you. Thank you very much.
Dad! You bowed! The photo is just the top of your head!
When there is a flash, I bow. It is polite.
He bowed at the dentist last week. During the X ray.
The hygienist clapped.
Okay. Again. No bowing. Just stand there like a grandpa.
Excuse me. Before we go again.
I would like a solo photo. A headshot. For my career.
She does not have a career. She has a bed shaped like a donut.
Fine. Everybody look at the phone. Three. Two. One.
Thank you! You are too kind!
He bowed again! And Duchess is sitting on Eli's head!
It is the best light in the room.
My eyes were closed anyway. This sweater is very itchy.
It is wool! It was Grandma's!
Grandma was itchy too. You can tell from the pictures.
Okay. New idea. A candid. We just laugh at a joke.
I know a joke. What does a cloud wear under its coat?
What?
Thunderwear.
Thank you. I'll be here all week.
Dad. You bowed. At your own joke.
It was a good joke. I would bow too. If I had a waist.
Why? Why do you bow every single time?
Thirty years, Renata. Thirty years.
Of the weather. Channel six. Every night at six.
Sunny tomorrow. Bow. Light rain. Bow. Snow day. Big bow.
Nobody remembers? Then who is that? Across the street?
Mom. There are forty people on the sidewalk.
Why are forty people on the sidewalk?
I put the photo shoot in the neighborhood newsletter.
Page one. Under the bake sale. Above the lost cat.
The lost cat is in the garage. He is fine. He is shy.
They have phones. They are taking pictures of us.
Every flash is a fan, Eli. And a fan gets a bow.
Missus Delgado brought a folding chair.
She has been to every forecast since nineteen ninety. She brings soup.
Mom. Look. Missus Delgado sent you her photo.
Oh. Oh no. It is beautiful.
We are all bowing. Even me. I did not know I bowed.
I am bowing too. Very gracefully. I have a waist after all.
Everybody is smiling. Under the sweaters. Upside down.
That is the card, Renata. That is the card.
Fine. That is the card. Happy holidays from the top of our heads.
Can I take the sweater off now?
No. They want an encore.
And my headshot.
Okay, everybody. Big finish. On three.
One more time. For the fans.
Three. Two. One.
Thank you. Thank you very much.
Tomorrow. Cloudy. Chance of encores.
And a lost cat. Found. In the garage.
Bow.
